summary: Verified all bug fixes: 1) Backend filename sanitization for images/documents using re.sub(r'[^\w.\-]', '_', filename) - handles macOS screenshot names with narrow no-break spaces. 2) Create New Contact button in Create Deal panel opens ContactFormPanel (not inline fields). 3) Document delete buttons added to PropertyIntelligencePanel and DealDetails. 4) Backend DELETE allows both doc uploader and deal owner to delete.

backend_image_sanitization.details: Filename sanitized with re.sub(r'[^\w.\-]', '_', file.filename) before Supabase Storage upload. Handles macOS screenshot names with narrow no-break spaces (U+202F).

backend_document_sanitization.details: Filename sanitized with re.sub(r'[^\w.\-]', '_', file.filename) before Supabase Storage upload.

backend_delete_allows_deal_owner.details: Joins deals table to check owner_id. Allows delete if user is doc uploader (owner_id) OR deal owner (deals.owner_id).

mapview_contactformpanel_rendered.details: ContactFormPanel rendered with isOpen={showCreateDealContactPanel}, onContactCreated callback sets createDealContact and closes panel

panel_document_upload_uses_backend.details: handleDocumentUpload uses fetch POST to ${API}/deals/${data.id}/documents (not direct Supabase)

panel_document_delete_button.details: handleDeleteDocument uses fetch DELETE. Each document row has Trash2 delete button.

dealdetails_document_delete_button.details: handleDeleteDocument uses fetch DELETE. Delete button with data-testid='delete-doc-${doc.id}' visible only to owner.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend filename sanitization (server.py lines 122, 272): Uses re.sub(r'[^\w.\-]', '_', filename) which correctly handles macOS screenshot names containing narrow no-break spaces (U+202F) and other special characters
MapView.js: Create New Contact button (line 1700-1707) opens ContactFormPanel instead of inline form fields - matches requirement
ContactFormPanel integration (MapView.js lines 1770-1779): onContactCreated callback correctly sets createDealContact state for linking to new deal
Document delete (server.py lines 206-214): Correctly allows both doc uploader AND deal owner to delete by joining deals table

test_credentials.note: CRM requires Supabase auth - verified through code review and endpoint existence tests
